validated_revision: 5d86db0b (evals; tt/, selected_precision_config.json and kv_capacity.json identical to 050f4a6b)
excluded: doc/ (except the precision config, kv_capacity.json and its 5 evidence files)

tt/readiness_contract.py.modification: provenance header comment; docstring example path models/autoports/<model_name> -> models/<bring-up dir>/<model_name>

modifications: tt/generator.py: readiness_check.contract and the absolute model import become relative imports.
tt/generator.py: device top_k limited to 32 (max_device_top_k, TTSampling max_top_k, top_k validation); requests with top_k > 32 sample on the host.
tt/generator_vllm.py: model_capabilities gains preserve_prefill_state_slots=True (plugin patch P1).
tt/multichip_decoder.py, tt/optimized_decoder.py: moe_fused_swiglu and post_combine_reduce call the ttnn.bringup forks (tt_metal patches tt-metal-bringup-moe-fused-swiglu / -post-combine-reduce).

doc/full_model/kv_capacity.json: source_sha256 of the 5 gated runtime files set to the vendored bytes (measured_source_sha256 keeps the bring-up hashes); the 60620-block measurement is from the bring-up base and must be re-measured at the pins.

tt/model.py: resolve_checkpoint() prefers the snapshot tt-inference-server mounts and exports as MODEL_WEIGHTS_DIR (or HF_MODEL) when it holds config.json and the safetensors (mounted_snapshot(); a hub snapshot directory must be the pinned revision), else $HF_HOME as before; kv_capacity.json source_sha256 tracks the edited file.

tt/multichip_decoder.py, tt/optimized_decoder.py: the masked_bincount expert histogram pads its token rows to a multiple of 64 (expert id 256, which the op skips) because the pinned op splits rows over a fixed 64-core grid; the bring-up base op needed a multiple of 8 (tt-metal ddc05756f49). Counts are unchanged; kv_capacity.json source_sha256 tracks both files.

tt/generator.py: _remap_penalties reshapes the penalty buffers in TILE layout instead of row-major, because the pinned row-major reshape sizes its circular buffers by the 1 MiB row page and exceeds L1 for the replicated 262144-wide buffer (the bring-up base uses the codegen row-major reshape, tt-metal d7f23025721). Same rows are moved (checked exact on device for all four buffers); kv_capacity.json source_sha256 tracks the file.

doc/full_model/kv_capacity.json: pool re-measured at the pins (60587 pass / 60588 OOM, was 60620 / 60621 at the base); physical_num_blocks, physical_token_capacity, max_tokens_all_users and the pass/fail pair updated, method and probes recorded under pin_measurement.
